{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "docs",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Changes to doc/ are release notes and REST interface updates that follow the code change.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Non-member; doc changes merely accompany the primary code modifications."
    },
    {
      "name": "indexes",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Directly modifies src/index/txindex.cpp and src/index/txindex.h to support running txindex on pruned nodes.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.72,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Enables txindex on pruned nodes, resolving multiple long-standing feature requests (issues #10609, #12651, #16182, #35240). By storing block hashes rather than file offsets, nodes can maintain transaction index coverage without storing hundreds of gigabytes of raw block history on disk."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Updates src/rpc/util.cpp and src/rpc/request.cpp to add structured error data support to JSONRPCError, and modifies getrawtransaction and gettxoutproof behavior.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Extends JSON-RPC error handling to return structured candidate block hashes in error.data and modifies getrawtransaction verbosity 2 to gracefully omit unavailable undo data. This provides structured feedback allowing callers to fetch missing pruned blocks via getblockfrompeer."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches test/functional/test_runner.py solely to register the new functional test feature_txindex_prune.py.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Non-member; the tests added are specific to validating txindex pruning behavior rather than test framework infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Changes in src/init.cpp adjust initialization checks to permit -txindex alongside -prune.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Non-member; the startup configuration check is specific to txindex and does not modify general utility primitives."
    }
  ],

    "leverage": 1
  }
}
